```{r sample_properties}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

## sample/subject properties at the top of the report (as in the PDF front page)
conf <- cps_report[["settings"]][["conf"]]
subject_sex <-
  if (is.null(conf$subject_properties$sex)) "UNKNOWN" else
    as.character(conf$subject_properties$sex)
subject_age <-
  if (is.null(conf$subject_properties$age) ||
      identical(conf$subject_properties$age, "NA")) "N/A" else
    as.character(conf$subject_properties$age)

panel_n_genes <-
  conf[["gene_panel"]][["panel_genes"]] |>
  dplyr::filter(PRIMARY_TARGET == T) |>
  dplyr::select(ENTREZGENE) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  NROW()

## name of the virtual panel: short display name (max. 42 characters),
## full name shown on hover
panel_name <- cpsr:::panel_display_name(conf, max_chars = 42)
panel_label <- htmltools::span(title = panel_name$full, panel_name$short)

## cards of fixed height (same look in every report); the panel name
## (max. 42 characters) fits in two lines of the wider middle card
sample_tile <- function(title, value) {
  bslib::value_box(
    title = title,
    value = value,
    showcase = NULL,
    height = "140px",
    fill = FALSE,
    theme = bslib::value_box_theme(
      bg = cpsr::color_palette[["report"]], fg = "#fff")
  )
}

bslib::layout_columns(
  col_widths = c(3, 6, 3),
  fill = FALSE,
  sample_tile("Sex / age at sampling",
              paste0(subject_sex, " / ", subject_age)),
  sample_tile("Virtual gene panel", panel_label),
  sample_tile("Genes in panel", paste0("n = ", panel_n_genes))
)
```
